_help: Each rule: name + any of min_inch, max_inch, max_price, res / not_res [list, e.g. UWQHD/4K/QHD/UWFHD], panel [list], min_hz, usbc_charge (true), min_discount (%), models (regex on model/title/description), any (regex that must appear), none (regex that must NOT appear), no_damage (true), max_km, allow_no_price (true = also listings without a price). A listing fires the first rule it matches. Test changes with: python -I alert.py test Global: min_inch drops listings whose known size is smaller; exclude_title skips accessory-only titles unless exclude_title_unless also matches. Phone push topic: data/ntfy_topic.txt locally, NTFY_TOPIC secret in GitHub Actions.
